## Project Status

This application is currently in **active development**. 

While we take security seriously, please note this project uses **LLM-accelerated development**. Due to rapid iteration and AI assistance, there may be undiscovered vulnerabilities or edge cases that have not been manually audited.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, we would greatly appreciate your feedback. Please report it to the maintainers privately (if possible) or by opening an issue in the repository. 

Your help in making this project safer is highly appreciated!
